CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.can_manage_company(target_company_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from neuvetra.company_members m join neuvetra.staging_access a
 on a.user_id=m.user_id and a.company_id=m.company_id
 where m.company_id=target_company_id and m.user_id=auth.uid() and a.active and m.role in ('owner','admin'))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.complete_annual_source_register(target_company_id uuid, prior_register_id uuid, register_id uuid, audit_id uuid, request_payload_json text, request_fixture_sha256 text, request_snapshot_sha256 text, request_idempotency_key uuid, request_operation_fingerprint text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare actor_id uuid := neuvetra.current_user_id(); stored_id uuid; prior record; payload jsonb := request_payload_json::jsonb;
begin
  if actor_id is null or not neuvetra.can_manage_company(target_company_id) then raise exception 'workspace not found' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  select * into prior from neuvetra.annual_source_register_versions where company_id=target_company_id and id=prior_register_id and version=1 and status='incomplete' for update;
  if prior.id is null then raise exception 'register conflict' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  if payload - 'snapshotSha256' is distinct from jsonb_build_object(
    'id',register_id,'companyId',target_company_id,'boundaryId',prior.boundary_id,'previousInventoryVersionId',prior.previous_inventory_version_id,
    'version',2,'reportingYear',2023,'facilityId',(prior.payload_json::jsonb)->'facilityId','status','resolved_with_exceptions',
    'counts',jsonb_build_object('expected',12,'resolved',12,'reported',10,'estimated',1,'excluded',1,'missing',0,'calculationBearing',11),
    'periods',jsonb_build_array(
      (prior.payload_json::jsonb)#>'{periods,0}',
      jsonb_build_object('month','2023-02','state','reported','version',2,'quantityMwh','11.982000','emissionsKgCo2e','2336.9727404016','evidence',jsonb_build_object('source','M58 fixed fictional electricity register','sha256',request_fixture_sha256,'locator','rows[0]'),'reason',null,'method',null,'formula',null,'basisMonths',jsonb_build_array()),
      jsonb_build_object('month','2023-03','state','reported','version',2,'quantityMwh','12.417000','emissionsKgCo2e','2421.8152660296','evidence',jsonb_build_object('source','M58 fixed fictional electricity register','sha256',request_fixture_sha256,'locator','rows[1]'),'reason',null,'method',null,'formula',null,'basisMonths',jsonb_build_array()),
      jsonb_build_object('month','2023-04','state','reported','version',2,'quantityMwh','11.876000','emissionsKgCo2e','2316.2984697888','evidence',jsonb_build_object('source','M58 fixed fictional electricity register','sha256',request_fixture_sha256,'locator','rows[2]'),'reason',null,'method',null,'formula',null,'basisMonths',jsonb_build_array()),
      jsonb_build_object('month','2023-05','state','reported','version',2,'quantityMwh','12.104000','emissionsKgCo2e','2360.7676556352','evidence',jsonb_build_object('source','M58 fixed fictional electricity register','sha256',request_fixture_sha256,'locator','rows[3]'),'reason',null,'method',null,'formula',null,'basisMonths',jsonb_build_array()),
      jsonb_build_object('month','2023-06','state','reported','version',2,'quantityMwh','13.228000','emissionsKgCo2e','2579.9929402464','evidence',jsonb_build_object('source','M58 fixed fictional electricity register','sha256',request_fixture_sha256,'locator','rows[4]'),'reason',null,'method',null,'formula',null,'basisMonths',jsonb_build_array()),
      jsonb_build_object('month','2023-07','state','reported','version',2,'quantityMwh','14.037000','emissionsKgCo2e','2737.7805338856','evidence',jsonb_build_object('source','M58 fixed fictional electricity register','sha256',request_fixture_sha256,'locator','rows[5]'),'reason',null,'method',null,'formula',null,'basisMonths',jsonb_build_array()),
      jsonb_build_object('month','2023-08','state','reported','version',2,'quantityMwh','13.812000','emissionsKgCo2e','2693.8964689056','evidence',jsonb_build_object('source','M58 fixed fictional electricity register','sha256',request_fixture_sha256,'locator','rows[6]'),'reason',null,'method',null,'formula',null,'basisMonths',jsonb_build_array()),
      jsonb_build_object('month','2023-09','state','reported','version',2,'quantityMwh','12.765000','emissionsKgCo2e','2489.689286532','evidence',jsonb_build_object('source','M58 fixed fictional electricity register','sha256',request_fixture_sha256,'locator','rows[7]'),'reason',null,'method',null,'formula',null,'basisMonths',jsonb_build_array()),
      jsonb_build_object('month','2023-10','state','reported','version',2,'quantityMwh','12.221000','emissionsKgCo2e','2383.5873694248','evidence',jsonb_build_object('source','M58 fixed fictional electricity register','sha256',request_fixture_sha256,'locator','rows[8]'),'reason',null,'method',null,'formula',null,'basisMonths',jsonb_build_array()),
      jsonb_build_object('month','2023-11','state','estimated','version',2,'quantityMwh','12.493000','emissionsKgCo2e','2436.6383279784','evidence',null,'reason','synthetic_november_statement_unavailable','method','mean_of_prior_two_reported_months_v1','formula','(12.765000 + 12.221000) / 2','basisMonths',jsonb_build_array('2023-09','2023-10')),
      jsonb_build_object('month','2023-12','state','excluded','version',2,'quantityMwh',null,'emissionsKgCo2e',null,'evidence',jsonb_build_object('source','M58 fixed fictional electricity register','sha256',request_fixture_sha256,'locator','closureMemo'),'reason','outside_operational_control_after_lease_end','method',null,'formula',null,'basisMonths',jsonb_build_array())
    ),
    'totals',jsonb_build_object('reportedMwh','126.788000','reportedKgCo2e','24728.7681363744','reportedDisplayKgCo2e','24728.7681','estimatedMwh','12.493000','estimatedKgCo2e','2436.6383279784','estimatedDisplayKgCo2e','2436.6383','includedMwh','139.281000','includedKgCo2e','27165.4064643528','includedDisplayKgCo2e','27165.4065'),
    'fixtureSha256',request_fixture_sha256
  ) then raise exception 'register contract mismatch' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(payload) is distinct from 'object' or (select count(*) from jsonb_object_keys(payload)) is distinct from 13::bigint or request_fixture_sha256 is distinct from '44cf813b31bf92a13e15a5432e26cd931355df7ded4684248759a50876dbdc29' or payload->>'id' is distinct from register_id::text or payload->>'companyId' is distinct from target_company_id::text
    or payload->>'boundaryId' is distinct from prior.boundary_id::text or payload->>'previousInventoryVersionId' is distinct from prior.previous_inventory_version_id::text or payload->>'version' is distinct from '2' or payload->>'status' is distinct from 'resolved_with_exceptions'
    or payload->>'fixtureSha256' is distinct from request_fixture_sha256 or payload->>'snapshotSha256' is distinct from request_snapshot_sha256 or jsonb_array_length(payload->'periods') is distinct from 12
    or payload#>>'{counts,expected}' is distinct from '12' or payload#>>'{counts,resolved}' is distinct from '12' or payload#>>'{counts,reported}' is distinct from '10' or payload#>>'{counts,estimated}' is distinct from '1' or payload#>>'{counts,excluded}' is distinct from '1' or payload#>>'{counts,missing}' is distinct from '0' or payload#>>'{counts,calculationBearing}' is distinct from '11'
    or payload#>>'{totals,reportedMwh}' is distinct from '126.788000' or payload#>>'{totals,reportedKgCo2e}' is distinct from '24728.7681363744' or payload#>>'{totals,estimatedMwh}' is distinct from '12.493000' or payload#>>'{totals,estimatedKgCo2e}' is distinct from '2436.6383279784' or payload#>>'{totals,includedMwh}' is distinct from '139.281000' or payload#>>'{totals,includedKgCo2e}' is distinct from '27165.4064643528' or payload#>>'{totals,includedDisplayKgCo2e}' is distinct from '27165.4065'
    or payload#>>'{periods,0,state}' is distinct from 'reported' or payload#>>'{periods,1,state}' is distinct from 'reported' or payload#>>'{periods,2,state}' is distinct from 'reported' or payload#>>'{periods,3,state}' is distinct from 'reported' or payload#>>'{periods,4,state}' is distinct from 'reported' or payload#>>'{periods,5,state}' is distinct from 'reported' or payload#>>'{periods,6,state}' is distinct from 'reported' or payload#>>'{periods,7,state}' is distinct from 'reported' or payload#>>'{periods,8,state}' is distinct from 'reported' or payload#>>'{periods,9,state}' is distinct from 'reported'
    or payload#>>'{periods,0,quantityMwh}' is distinct from '12.346000' or payload#>>'{periods,1,quantityMwh}' is distinct from '11.982000' or payload#>>'{periods,2,quantityMwh}' is distinct from '12.417000' or payload#>>'{periods,3,quantityMwh}' is distinct from '11.876000' or payload#>>'{periods,4,quantityMwh}' is distinct from '12.104000' or payload#>>'{periods,5,quantityMwh}' is distinct from '13.228000' or payload#>>'{periods,6,quantityMwh}' is distinct from '14.037000' or payload#>>'{periods,7,quantityMwh}' is distinct from '13.812000' or payload#>>'{periods,8,quantityMwh}' is distinct from '12.765000' or payload#>>'{periods,9,quantityMwh}' is distinct from '12.221000'
    or payload#>>'{periods,1,evidence,sha256}' is distinct from request_fixture_sha256 or payload#>>'{periods,9,evidence,sha256}' is distinct from request_fixture_sha256
    or payload#>>'{periods,10,state}' is distinct from 'estimated' or payload#>>'{periods,10,quantityMwh}' is distinct from '12.493000' or payload#>>'{periods,10,method}' is distinct from 'mean_of_prior_two_reported_months_v1' or payload#>>'{periods,10,reason}' is distinct from 'synthetic_november_statement_unavailable'
    or payload#>>'{periods,11,state}' is distinct from 'excluded' or payload#>>'{periods,11,reason}' is distinct from 'outside_operational_control_after_lease_end' or payload#>'{periods,11,quantityMwh}' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb or payload#>'{periods,11,emissionsKgCo2e}' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
  then raise exception 'register contract mismatch' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  insert into neuvetra.annual_source_register_versions values
    (register_id,target_company_id,prior.boundary_id,prior.previous_inventory_version_id,2,'resolved_with_exceptions',request_payload_json,request_fixture_sha256,request_snapshot_sha256,request_idempotency_key,request_operation_fingerprint,actor_id,now())
    on conflict (company_id,boundary_id,version) do nothing returning id into stored_id;
  if stored_id is null then select id into stored_id from neuvetra.annual_source_register_versions where company_id=target_company_id and boundary_id=prior.boundary_id and previous_inventory_version_id=prior.previous_inventory_version_id and version=2 and fixture_sha256=request_fixture_sha256; end if;
  if stored_id is null then raise exception 'register conflict' using errcode='23505'; end if;
  insert into neuvetra.annual_inventory_audit_log values(audit_id,target_company_id,actor_id,'annual_register.completed',stored_id,jsonb_build_object('version',2,'snapshot_sha256',request_snapshot_sha256),now()) on conflict do nothing;

end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.create_annual_source_register(target_company_id uuid, prior_inventory_id uuid, register_id uuid, audit_id uuid, request_payload_json text, request_snapshot_sha256 text, request_idempotency_key uuid, request_operation_fingerprint text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare actor_id uuid := neuvetra.current_user_id(); stored_id uuid; predecessor record; payload jsonb := request_payload_json::jsonb;
begin
  if actor_id is null or not neuvetra.can_manage_company(target_company_id) then raise exception 'workspace not found' using errcode='42501'; end if;
  select i.boundary_id, i.calculation_id, i.calculation_result_sha256, c.facility_id, d.outcome into predecessor from neuvetra.inventory_versions i
    join neuvetra.inventory_review_decisions d on d.company_id=i.company_id and d.inventory_version_id=i.id
    join neuvetra.inventory_calculation_results c on c.company_id=i.company_id and c.id=i.calculation_id

values((report_payload->>'id')::uuid,target_company,target_roster,v.id,report_payload,report_payload->>'reportSha256',actor,(report_payload->>'createdAt')::timestamptz);insert into neuvetra.stationary_equipment_requests values(target_company,(request->>'idempotencyKey')::uuid,actor,'report',fingerprint,(report_payload->>'id')::uuid);insert into neuvetra.stationary_equipment_audit values(gen_random_uuid(),target_company,(report_payload->>'id')::uuid,'report',report_payload->>'reportSha256',actor,(report_payload->>'createdAt')::timestamptz);return (report_payload->>'id')::uuid;end $function$

functions.signature: neuvetra.create_synthetic_bill_calculation(target_company_id uuid, target_evidence_id uuid, target_activity_id uuid, calculation_id uuid, audit_id uuid, request_idempotency_key uuid, request_operation_fingerprint text, canonical_result_json text)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.create_synthetic_bill_calculation(target_company_id uuid, target_evidence_id uuid, target_activity_id uuid, calculation_id uuid, audit_id uuid, request_idempotency_key uuid, request_operation_fingerprint text, canonical_result_json text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  actor_id uuid := neuvetra.current_user_id();
  payload jsonb;
  stored_id uuid;
  linked record;
begin
  if actor_id is null then raise exception 'authentication required' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if not neuvetra.can_manage_company(target_company_id) then raise exception 'workspace not found' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if request_operation_fingerprint !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' then raise exception 'calculation contract mismatch' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
  begin payload := canonical_result_json::jsonb;
  exception when others then raise exception 'calculation contract mismatch' using errcode = '22023'; end;

  select a.bill_version_id, v.evidence_id, a.facility_id, a.boundary_id, j.id extraction_id, v.previous_version_id
    into linked
  from neuvetra.inventory_activity_versions a
  join neuvetra.bill_versions v on v.id = a.bill_version_id and v.company_id = a.company_id
  join neuvetra.bill_versions prior on prior.id = v.previous_version_id and prior.company_id = v.company_id
  join neuvetra.bill_evidence e on e.id = v.evidence_id and e.company_id = v.company_id
  join neuvetra.extraction_jobs j on j.evidence_id = e.id and j.company_id = e.company_id
  join neuvetra.facilities f on f.id = a.facility_id and f.company_id = a.company_id
  join neuvetra.reporting_boundaries b on b.id = a.boundary_id and b.company_id = a.company_id
  join neuvetra.boundary_facilities bf on bf.company_id = a.company_id and bf.boundary_id = a.boundary_id and bf.facility_id = a.facility_id
  where a.company_id = target_company_id and a.id = target_activity_id
    and v.evidence_id = target_evidence_id and v.version = 2 and prior.version = 1
    and v.electricity_kwh = 12346.000 and v.correction_reason = 'Synthetic review exercise'
    and a.bill_version_id = v.id and a.quantity_mwh = 12.346000 and a.unit = 'MWh' and a.status = 'draft'
    and a.facility_id = v.facility_id and f.name = 'Synthetic California office' and f.egrid_subregion = 'CAMX'
    and b.reporting_year = 2023 and b.approach = 'operational_control' and b.status = 'draft' and b.version = 1
    and e.sha256 = '0a97cd0976c03af0776214fc19bdc3d4f0c00e9c835f3e116574a6f375c8e135'
    and j.parser_version = 'm55-fixed-pdf-v1' and j.status = 'completed'
  for update of a, v, b;
  if linked.bill_version_id is null then raise exception 'calculation source not found' using errcode = '42501'; end if;

  if payload->>'contract_version' <> 'm56-linked-bill-calculation-result-v1'
    or payload->>'status' <> 'calculated'
    or payload#>>'{activity,quantity}' <> '12.346000'
    or payload#>>'{activity,unit}' <> 'MWh'
    or payload#>>'{activity,geography,egrid_subregion}' <> 'CAMX'
    or payload#>>'{activity,activity_period,start}' <> '2023-01-01'
    or payload#>>'{activity,activity_period,end}' <> '2023-01-31'
    or payload#>>'{conversion,id}' <> 'exact-kwh-to-mwh-v1'
    or payload#>>'{conversion,source}' <> '12346.000 kWh'
    or payload#>>'{conversion,result}' <> '12.346000 MWh'
    or payload#>>'{method,id}' <> 'scope2-location-based-egrid-subregion'
    or payload#>>'{method,version}' <> '2023-r2-camx-v1'
    or payload#>>'{factor,candidate_sha256}' <> '8770ae6238df8525e5250850fab248c934be33f459ed19cc1fa24bd0718cb356'
    or payload#>>'{factor,source,workbook_sha256}' <> '3dfbbcf2f949d58d5b2dbee3aab8150bd04a0c8ebb730ba1cd37a013bd4450ab'
    or payload#>>'{factor,total_output_co2e,value}' <> '195.0402888'
    or payload#>>'{factor,total_output_co2e,cell}' <> 'AI6'
    or payload#>>'{gwp_policy,policy_sha256}' <> 'fd9fd8973012da1a232dad7fc00db3013194751a92b34ab21dfd4f7b2c5148c5'
    or payload->>'input_snapshot_sha256' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    or payload#>>'{total,unrounded}' <> '2407.9674055248'
    or payload#>>'{total,display}' <> '2407.9674'
    or payload#>>'{reconciliation,component_sum}' <> '2407.8330020304'
    or payload#>>'{reconciliation,component_rounding_delta}' <> '0.1344034944'
    or payload#>>'{classification,factor}' <> 'development_candidate'
    or payload#>>'{classification,runtime}' <> 'not_released'
    or (payload#>>'{classification,release_eligible}')::boolean <> false
    or payload->>'result_payload_sha256' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    or payload#>>'{method,adapter_implementation_sha256}' <> 'ae03b9146060187c63b6f3b8a253fbd61cd4f97a9aa97905481904eca45b061e'
    or payload#>>'{method,reviewed_engine_sha256}' <> '4ad28f3877d13f238bbbf7e8bfb1fc6241922b9def73712ec1b02fd80b51b82c'
    or payload#>>'{method,authority_record_sha256}' <> '9c63b2cb12fa2708f35d394e537ca5803e27f91c4647f33376abf75a6fb72b91'
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,company_id}' <> target_company_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,evidence_id}' <> target_evidence_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,activity_version_id}' <> target_activity_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,bill_version_id}' <> linked.bill_version_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,facility_id}' <> linked.facility_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,boundary_id}' <> linked.boundary_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,extraction_id}' <> linked.extraction_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,previous_bill_version_id}' <> linked.previous_version_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,parser_version}' <> 'm55-fixed-pdf-v1'
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,activity_version}' <> '1'
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,correction_reason}' <> 'Synthetic review exercise'
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,service_period,start}' <> '2023-01-01'
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,service_period,end}' <> '2023-01-31'
    or payload#>>'{gas_results,co2,mass}' <> '2399.4607843584'
    or payload#>>'{gas_results,ch4,mass}' <> '0.14000364'
    or payload#>>'{gas_results,ch4,co2e}' <> '3.92010192'
    or payload#>>'{gas_results,n2o,mass}' <> '0.0168004368'
    or payload#>>'{gas_results,n2o,co2e}' <> '4.452115752'
    or payload#>>'{trace,0,step}' <> 'reviewed_bill_conversion'
    or payload#>>'{trace,1,result}' <> '2407.9674055248'
    or payload#>>'{trace,2,result}' <> '2407.8330020304'
    or payload#>>'{trace,3,result}' <> '0.1344034944'
  then raise exception 'calculation contract mismatch' using errcode = '22023'; end if;

  insert into neuvetra.inventory_calculation_results (
    id, company_id, activity_version_id, bill_version_id, evidence_id, facility_id, boundary_id,
    method_id, method_version, adapter_implementation_sha256, reviewed_engine_sha256, authority_record_sha256, factor_id, factor_version,
    factor_candidate_sha256, source_sha256, gwp_policy_id, gwp_policy_version, gwp_policy_sha256,
    input_snapshot_sha256, result_payload_sha256, source_quantity_kwh, normalized_quantity_mwh,
    unrounded_kg_co2e, display_kg_co2e, status, classification, release_eligible,
    result_payload_json, result_payload, idempotency_key, operation_fingerprint, created_by
  ) values (
    calculation_id, target_company_id, target_activity_id, linked.bill_version_id, linked.evidence_id,
    linked.facility_id, linked.boundary_id, payload#>>'{method,id}', payload#>>'{method,version}',
    payload#>>'{method,adapter_implementation_sha256}', payload#>>'{method,reviewed_engine_sha256}', payload#>>'{method,authority_record_sha256}', payload#>>'{factor,id}', payload#>>'{factor,version}',
    payload#>>'{factor,candidate_sha256}', payload#>>'{factor,source,workbook_sha256}',
    payload#>>'{gwp_policy,id}', payload#>>'{gwp_policy,version}', payload#>>'{gwp_policy,policy_sha256}',
    payload->>'input_snapshot_sha256', payload->>'result_payload_sha256', 12346.000, 12.346000,
    2407.9674055248, 2407.9674, 'draft', 'development_candidate', false,
    canonical_result_json, payload, request_idempotency_key, request_operation_fingerprint, actor_id
  ) on conflict (company_id, activity_version_id, method_version) do nothing returning id into stored_id;

  if stored_id is null then
    select id into stored_id from neuvetra.inventory_calculation_results
      where company_id = target_company_id and activity_version_id = target_activity_id and method_version = '2023-r2-camx-v1'
        and result_payload = payload and result_payload_json = canonical_result_json
        and operation_fingerprint = request_operation_fingerprint;
    if stored_id is null then raise exception 'calculation conflict' using errcode = '23505'; end if;
    return stored_id;
  end if;

  insert into neuvetra.calculation_audit_log values (
    audit_id, target_company_id, actor_id, stored_id, 'calculation.created',
    jsonb_build_object('activity_version_id', target_activity_id, 'method_version', '2023-r2-camx-v1', 'result_payload_sha256', payload->>'result_payload_sha256'), now()
  );
  return stored_id;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.m73_pair(label text, v text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$declare out jsonb:='[{"code":"scope1_incomplete","message":"This vehicle mobile-combustion subtotal does not complete stationary, mobile, fugitive or process emissions."},{"code":"method_not_released","message":"Factors and method are development candidates; no reporting or assurance determination."}]';s jsonb:=neuvetra.m74_activity_status(a);begin
if a->'quantityGallons'='null' then out:=out||'[{"code":"fuel_activity_missing","message":"Consumed gallons are missing; no emissions were calculated."}]';end if;if a->'distanceMiles'='null' then out:=out||'[{"code":"mileage_activity_missing","message":"Vehicle-miles are missing; no emissions were calculated."}]';end if;if a->'fuelStatement'='null' then out:=out||'[{"code":"fuel_statement_missing","message":"No synthetic annual fuel statement is retained."}]';end if;if a->'mileageStatement'='null' then out:=out||'[{"code":"mileage_statement_missing","message":"No synthetic annual mileage statement is retained."}]';end if;if s->>'fuel'='unconfirmed' then out:=out||'[{"code":"fuel_statement_unconfirmed","message":"The synthetic fuel assumptions have not been manually confirmed."}]';end if;if s->>'mileage'='unconfirmed' then out:=out||'[{"code":"mileage_statement_unconfirmed","message":"The synthetic mileage assumptions have not been manually confirmed."}]';end if;if s->>'fuel'='discrepancy' then out:=out||'[{"code":"fuel_activity_statement_discrepancy","message":"Entered and stated consumed gallons differ; the discrepancy remains unresolved."}]';end if;if s->>'mileage'='discrepancy' then out:=out||'[{"code":"mileage_activity_statement_discrepancy","message":"Entered and stated vehicle-miles differ; the discrepancy remains unresolved."}]';end if;if a->'quantityGallons'<>'null' and a->'distanceMiles'<>'null' and ((a->>'quantityGallons'='0.000')<>(a->>'distanceMiles'='0.000')) then out:=out||'[{"code":"mixed_zero_contradiction","message":"Zero in only one activity dimension is outside this bounded method; no emissions were calculated."}]';end if;if a->>'quantityGallons'='0.000' and a->>'distanceMiles'='0.000' and not neuvetra.m74_can_calculate(a) then out:=out||'[{"code":"unsupported_zero","message":"Zero activity needs matching zero statements, both confirmations and a no-operation/no-consumption reason."}]';end if;return out;end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.m75_acceptance_ready(target_company uuid, version_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$with cv as(select v.payload from neuvetra.corporate_inventory_heads h join neuvetra.corporate_inventory_versions v on v.id=h.version_id and v.company_id=h.company_id join neuvetra.corporate_inventory_reviews r on r.version_id=v.id and r.company_id=v.company_id where h.company_id=target_company and r.payload->>'decision'='accepted_bounded_internal'),assets as(select a from jsonb_array_elements(version_payload#>'{activity,rosterStatement,assets}') a),links as(select l from jsonb_array_elements(version_payload#>'{activity,links}') l),sources as(select s from cv,jsonb_array_elements(cv.payload#>'{snapshot,sources}') s where s->>'domain'='mobile_combustion'),wps as(select v.payload p,r.payload review from neuvetra.mobile_diesel_heads h join neuvetra.mobile_diesel_versions v on v.id=h.version_id and v.company_id=h.company_id join neuvetra.mobile_diesel_reviews r on r.version_id=v.id and r.company_id=v.company_id where h.company_id=target_company) select exists(select 1 from cv) and version_payload->'findings'='[]'::jsonb and version_payload#>>'{activity,manualConfirmation}'='true' and version_payload#>>'{activity,rosterStatement,completeness}'='declared_complete' and version_payload#>>'{activity,rosterStatement,allTripLocationsIncluded}'='true' and (select count(*) from assets)=(select count(*) from links) and (select count(*) from assets)=(select count(*) from sources) and (select count(*) from assets)=(select count(*) from wps) and not exists(select 1 from sources s where not exists(select 1 from cv,jsonb_array_elements(cv.payload#>'{snapshot,coverageItems}') i where i->>'sourceId'=s.s->>'id' and i->>'disposition'='included_activity')) and version_payload#>'{activity,rosterStatement,coveredEntityIds}'=(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e->>'id') order by e->>'id') from cv,jsonb_array_elements(cv.payload#>'{snapshot,entities}') e) and not exists(select 1 from assets a where a.a->>'mode'<>'on_road' or a.a->>'vehicleClass'<>'Medium- and Heavy-Duty Vehicles' or (a.a->>'modelYear')::integer not between 2007 and 2022 or a.a->>'fuel'<>'Fossil Diesel' or a.a->>'controlBasis'<>'owned_operational_control_full_year' or a.a#>>'{period,start}'<>'2025-01-01' or a.a#>>'{period,endExclusive}'<>'2026-01-01') and not exists(select 1 from(select id,count(*) n from(select a->>'assetId' id from assets where a->>'assetId' is not null union all select alias#>>'{}' from assets cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(a->'aliases') alias) identities group by id having count(*)>1) d) and not exists(select 1 from links group by l->>'sourceId' having count(*)>1) and not exists(select 1 from links l where not exists(select 1 from assets a where a.a->>'rowId'=l.l->>'rowId') or not exists(select 1 from sources s where s.s->>'id'=l.l->>'sourceId') or not exists(select 1 from wps w,assets a where a.a->>'rowId'=l.l->>'rowId' and w.p#>>'{activity,binding,sourceId}'=l.l->>'sourceId' and (w.p#>>'{activity,vehicle,assetId}'=a.a->>'assetId' or (a.a->'aliases') ? (w.p#>>'{activity,vehicle,assetId}')) and w.p#>>'{activity,binding,entityId}'=a.a->>'entityId' and w.p#>>'{activity,binding,facilityId}'=a.a->>'facilityId' and w.p#>>'{activity,vehicle,vehicleClass}'=a.a->>'vehicleClass' and w.p#>>'{activity,vehicle,modelYear}'=a.a->>'modelYear' and w.p#>>'{activity,vehicle,fuel}'=a.a->>'fuel' and w.p#>>'{activity,vehicle,controlBasis}'=a.a->>'controlBasis' and w.p->'calculation'<>'null'::jsonb and w.p#>>'{activityStatus,fuel}' in('entered','explicit_zero') and w.p#>>'{activityStatus,mileage}' in('entered','explicit_zero') and w.p#>>'{activity,binding,coverageVersionId}'=(neuvetra.m75_current_dependencies(target_company)#>>'{coveragePin,id}') and w.p#>>'{activity,binding,coverageVersionSha256}'=(neuvetra.m75_current_dependencies(target_company)#>>'{coveragePin,sha256}') and w.review->>'decision'='accepted_bounded_internal' and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(w.p->'findings') f where f->>'code' not in('scope1_incomplete','method_not_released'))))$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.m75_activity_valid(activity jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra'
AS $function$declare s jsonb;a jsonb;l jsonb;p jsonb;begin if not neuvetra.m75_exact_keys(activity,array['profile','coverageVersionId','coverageVersionSha256','period','rosterStatement','manualConfirmation','links']) or activity->>'profile' is distinct from 'synthetic-controlled-fleet-v1' or activity->>'coverageVersionId'!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' or activity->>'coverageVersionSha256'!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' or activity->'period' is distinct from jsonb_build_object('start','2025-01-01','endExclusive','2026-01-01') or jsonb_typeof(activity->'manualConfirmation') is distinct from 'boolean' or jsonb_typeof(activity->'links') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(activity->'links')>25 then return false;end if;s:=activity->'rosterStatement';if s='null'::jsonb then return activity->'links'='[]'::jsonb;end if;if not neuvetra.m75_exact_keys(s,array['issuer','reference','description','discoveryBasis','coveredEntityIds','completeness','allTripLocationsIncluded','assets']) or not neuvetra.m75_text_valid(s->'issuer',120) or not neuvetra.m75_text_valid(s->'reference',120) or not neuvetra.m75_text_valid(s->'description',2000) or not neuvetra.m75_text_valid(s->'discoveryBasis',2000) or jsonb_typeof(s->'coveredEntityIds') is distinct from 'array' or s->>'completeness' not in('declared_complete','partial','unknown') or jsonb_typeof(s->'allTripLocationsIncluded') is distinct from 'boolean' or jsonb_typeof(s->'assets') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(s->'assets')>25 then return false;end if;if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(s->'coveredEntityIds') x where jsonb_typeof(x)<>'string' or x#>>'{}'!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$') or s->'coveredEntityIds' is distinct from (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x#>>'{}' collate "C"),'[]'::jsonb) from(select distinct x from jsonb_array_elements(s->'coveredEntityIds') x) q) then return false;end if;for a in select x from jsonb_array_elements(s->'assets') x loop if not neuvetra.m75_exact_keys(a,array['rowId','assetId','aliases','entityId','facilityId','period','mode','vehicleClass','modelYear','fuel','controlBasis','classificationBasis','controlExplanation']) or a->>'rowId'!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' or (a->'assetId'<>'null'::jsonb and (jsonb_typeof(a->'assetId')<>'string' or a->>'assetId'!~'^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9._-]{0,63}$')) or jsonb_typeof(a->'aliases') is distinct from 'array' or jsonb_array_length(a->'aliases')>8 or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(a->'aliases') x where jsonb_typeof(x)<>'string' or x#>>'{}'!~'^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9._-]{0,63}$') or a->'aliases' is distinct from (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x#>>'{}' collate "C"),'[]'::jsonb) from(select distinct x from jsonb_array_elements(a->'aliases') x) q) or (a->'assetId'<>'null'::jsonb and (a->'aliases') ? (a->>'assetId')) or (a->'entityId'<>'null'::jsonb and (jsonb_typeof(a->'entityId')<>'string' or a->>'entityId'!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')) or (a->'facilityId'<>'null'::jsonb and (jsonb_typeof(a->'facilityId')<>'string' or a->>'facilityId'!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')) or (a->'period'<>'null'::jsonb and (not neuvetra.m75_exact_keys(a->'period',array['start','endExclusive']) or a#>>'{period,start}'!~'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' or a#>>'{period,endExclusive}'!~'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' or to_char(to_date(a#>>'{period,start}','FXYYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')<>a#>>'{period,start}' or to_char(to_date(a#>>'{period,endExclusive}','FXYYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')<>a#>>'{period,endExclusive}' or a#>>'{period,start}'>=a#>>'{period,endExclusive}')) or a->>'mode' not in('on_road','off_road','rail','marine','air','other','unknown') or (a->'vehicleClass'<>'null'::jsonb and not neuvetra.m75_text_valid(a->'vehicleClass',100)) or (a->'modelYear'<>'null'::jsonb and (jsonb_typeof(a->'modelYear')<>'number' or a->>'modelYear'!~'^\d{4}$' or (a->>'modelYear')::integer not between 1900 and 2100)) or (a->'fuel'<>'null'::jsonb and not neuvetra.m75_text_valid(a->'fuel',100)) or a->>'controlBasis' not in('owned_operational_control_full_year','other_control_arrangement','unknown') or (a->'classificationBasis'<>'null'::jsonb and not neuvetra.m75_text_valid(a->'classificationBasis',500)) or (a->'controlExplanation'<>'null'::jsonb and not neuvetra.m75_text_valid(a->'controlExplanation',500)) then return false;end if;end loop;if (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(s->'assets'))<>(select count(distinct x->>'rowId') from jsonb_array_elements(s->'assets') x) then return false;end if;for l in select x from jsonb_array_elements(activity->'links') x loop if not neuvetra.m75_exact_keys(l,array['rowId','sourceId']) or l->>'rowId'!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' or (l->'sourceId'<>'null'::jsonb and (jsonb_typeof(l->'sourceId')<>'string' or l->>'sourceId'!~'^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$')) then return false;end if;end loop;return (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(activity->'links'))=(select count(distinct x->>'rowId') from jsonb_array_elements(activity->'links') x) and (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x->>'rowId') order by x->>'rowId' collate "C") from jsonb_array_elements(activity->'links') x)=(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x->>'rowId') order by x->>'rowId' collate "C") from jsonb_array_elements(s->'assets') x);exception when others then return false;end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.m75_current_dependencies(target_company uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$with coverage as(select v.id,v.version_sha256,r.id review_id,r.decision_sha256 from neuvetra.corporate_inventory_heads h join neuvetra.corporate_inventory_versions v on(v.company_id=h.company_id and v.id=h.version_id) left join neuvetra.corporate_inventory_reviews r on(r.company_id=v.company_id and r.version_id=v.id) where h.company_id=target_company),pins as(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('worksheetId',v.worksheet_id,'sourceId',v.payload#>'{activity,binding,sourceId}','assetId',v.payload#>'{activity,vehicle,assetId}','version',jsonb_build_object('id',v.id,'sha256',v.version_sha256),'decision',case when r.id is null then 'null'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'sha256',r.decision_sha256)end) order by v.worksheet_id),'[]'::jsonb) value from neuvetra.mobile_diesel_heads h join neuvetra.mobile_diesel_versions v on(v.company_id=h.company_id and v.id=h.version_id) left join neuvetra.mobile_diesel_reviews r on(r.company_id=v.company_id and r.version_id=v.id) where h.company_id=target_company),body as(select jsonb_build_object('coveragePin',case when c.id is null then 'null'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'sha256',c.version_sha256)end,'coverageReviewPin',case when c.review_id is null then 'null'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object('id',c.review_id,'sha256',c.decision_sha256)end,'workpaperPins',p.value) value from pins p left join coverage c on true) select value||jsonb_build_object('dependencySha256',neuvetra.m67_hash(value)) from body$function$

h.company_id=target_company),assets as(select a from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(activity#>'{rosterStatement,assets}','[]'::jsonb)) a),links as(select l from jsonb_array_elements(activity->'links') (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e->>'id') order by e->>'id') from cv,jsonb_array_elements(cv.payload#>'{snapshot,entities}') e) or exists(select 1 from assets a where a.a->>'assetId' is null or a.a->>'entityId' is null or a.a->>'facilityId' is null or a.a->'period'='null'::jsonb or a.a->>'mode'='unknown' or a.a->>'vehicleClass' is null or a.a->>'modelYear' is null or a.a->>'fuel' is null or a.a->>'controlBasis'='unknown' or a.a->>'classificationBasis' is null or a.a->>'controlExplanation' is null or not exists(select 1 from cv,jsonb_array_elements(cv.payload#>'{snapshot,entities}') e where e->>'id'=a.a->>'entityId') or not exists(select 1 from cv,jsonb_array_elements(cv.payload#>'{snapshot,facilities}') f where f->>'id'=a.a->>'facilityId' and f->>'entityId'=a.a->>'entityId') or a.a->>'mode'<>'on_road' or a.a->>'vehicleClass'<>'Medium- and Heavy-Duty Vehicles' or (a.a->>'modelYear')::integer not between 2007 and 2022 or a.a->>'fuel'<>'Fossil Diesel' or having count(*)>1) or exists(select 1 from links where l->>'sourceId' is not null group by l->>'sourceId' having count(*)>1)$function$

from neuvetra.corporate_inventory_heads h join neuvetra.corporate_inventory_versions v on v.company_id=h.company_id and v.id=h.version_id,jsonb_array_elements(v.payload#>'{snapshot,sources}') s where h.company_id=target_company and s->>'domain'='mobile_combustion'),wps as(select h.id worksheet_id,v.payload p from neuvetra.mobile_diesel_heads h join neuvetra.mobile_diesel_versions v on v.company_id=h.company_id and v.id=h.version_id where h.company_id=target_company),links as(select l from rec,jsonb_array_elements(rec.v#>'{activity,links}') l),expected_keys as(select 'roster:'||(a->>'rowId') k from rec,jsonb_array_elements(rec.v#>'{activity,rosterStatement,assets}') a union all select 'source:'||(s->>'id') from sources where not exists(select 1 from links where l->>'sourceId'=s->>'id') union all select 'workpaper:'||worksheet_id::text from wps where not exists(select 1 from links where l->>'sourceId'=p#>>'{activity,binding,sourceId}') and not exists(select 1 from sources where s->>'id'=p#>>'{activity,binding,sourceId}')) select neuvetra.m75_exact_keys(r,array['profile','companyId','period','rosterPin','rosterReviewPin','coveragePin','coverageReviewPin','workpaperPins','rows','findings','counts','status','dependencySha256','limitations','synthetic','scope1Completeness','corporateCompleteness','releaseEligible','assurance','emissionsTotals','contentSha256']) and r->>'profile'='m75-fleet-reconciliation-v1' and r->>'companyId'=target_company::text and r->'period'=jsonb_build_object('start','2025-01-01','endExclusive','2026-01-01') and r->'rosterPin'=jsonb_build_object('id',v->'id','sha256',v->'versionSha256') and r->'rosterReviewPin' is not distinct from case when review='null'::jsonb then 'null'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object('id',review->'id','sha256',review->'decisionSha256') end and r->'coveragePin'=d#>'{coveragePin}' and r->'coverageReviewPin'=d#>'{coverageReviewPin}' and r->'workpaperPins'=d->'workpaperPins' and r->>'dependencySha256'=d->>'dependencySha256' and r->>'synthetic'='true' and r->>'scope1Completeness'='incomplete' and r->>'corporateCompleteness'='incomplete' and r->>'releaseEligible'='false' and r->>'assurance'='none' and r->'emissionsTotals'='null'::jsonb and r->'limitations'='["synthetic_only","declared_roster_reconciliation_only","scope1_incomplete","corporate_inventory_incomplete","factor_and_method_not_released","no_emissions_aggregation","requirements_not_determined","no_external_assurance"]'::jsonb and r#>>'{counts,evidenceRows}'=(jsonb_array_length(coalesce(v#>'{activity,rosterStatement,assets}','[]'::jsonb)))::text and r#>>'{counts,declaredUniqueKnownAssets}'=(select count(distinct a->>'assetId')::text from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v#>'{activity,rosterStatement,assets}','[]'::jsonb)) a where a->>'assetId' is not null) and r#>>'{counts,currentMobileSources}'=(select count(*)::text from sources) and r#>>'{counts,currentWorkpaperStreams}'=(select count(*)::text from wps) and r#>>'{counts,reconciledRows}'=(select count(*)::text from jsonb_array_elements(r->'rows') x where x->>'status'='matched_reviewed') and r#>>'{counts,blockingFindings}'=(select count(*)::text from jsonb_array_elements(r->'findings') f where f->>'blocking'='true') and (select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x->>'rowKey') order by (x->>'rowKey') collate "C") from jsonb_array_elements(r->'rows') x)=(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(k) order by k collate "C") from expected_keys) and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(r->'rows') x where not neuvetra.m75_exact_keys(x,array['rowKey','rosterRowId','sourceId','assetId','worksheetIds','entityLabel','facilityLabel','sourceLabel','status','findings'])) and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(r->'findings') f where not neuvetra.m75_exact_keys(f,array['code','rowKey','message','blocking']) or f->>'blocking'<>'true') and r->>'contentSha256'=neuvetra.m67_hash(r-'contentSha256') from rec,deps$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.m76_diesel_activity_status(a jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$select case when a->'quantityGallons'='null'::jsonb then 'missing' when a->'statement'='null'::jsonb then 'evidence_missing' when a->'manualConfirmation'<>'true'::jsonb then 'unconfirmed' when a->>'quantityGallons'<>a#>>'{statement,statedQuantityGallons}' then 'discrepancy' when a->>'quantityGallons'='0.000' then case when neuvetra.m76_diesel_can_calculate(a) then 'explicit_zero' else 'unsupported_zero' end else 'entered' end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.m76_diesel_can_calculate(a jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$select a->'quantityGallons'<>'null'::jsonb and a->'statement'<>'null'::jsonb and a->'manualConfirmation'='true'::jsonb and (case when a->>'quantityGallons'='0.000' then a#>>'{statement,statedQuantityGallons}'='0.000' and a->'zeroReason'<>'null'::jsonb else a->>'quantityGallons'=a#>>'{statement,statedQuantityGallons}' or a->'discrepancyReason'<>'null'::jsonb end)$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.m76_diesel_capacity(target_company uuid, new_bytes integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$declare used_bytes bigint;begin
select coalesce((select sum(octet_length(convert_to(export_text,'utf8'))+4096) from neuvetra.stationary_diesel_versions where company_id=target_company),0)+coalesce((select sum(octet_length(convert_to(payload::text,'utf8'))) from neuvetra.stationary_diesel_reports where company_id=target_company),0) into used_bytes;
if used_bytes+new_bytes>3800000 then raise exception 'history bytes limit' using errcode='54001';end if;end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.m77_reconciliation(target_company uuid, coverage jsonb, workpapers jsonb, population jsonb, review jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare deps jsonb:=neuvetra.m77_dependencies(coverage,workpapers);d jsonb:=(population#>'{activity,declaration}');findings jsonb:='[]';assets jsonb:=coalesce(nullif((d->'assets'),'null'::jsonb),'[]');sources jsonb:=coalesce((select jsonb_agg(x order by n)from jsonb_array_elements((coverage#>'{snapshot,sources}'))with ordinality q(x,n)where (x->>'domain')='fugitive'),'[]');a jsonb;s jsonb;w jsonb;x jsonb;ws jsonb;body jsonb;begin
if coverage is null then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('coverage_missing','Corporate coverage is missing.');end if;if (coverage#>>'{review,decision}')is distinct from 'accepted_bounded_internal'then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('coverage_review_required','Corporate coverage requires separate internal review.');end if;if population is null then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('population_missing','Independent physical fugitive population has not been declared.');end if;if population is not null and((population#>>'{activity,coverageVersionId}')is distinct from (coverage->>'id')or (population#>>'{activity,coverageVersionSha256}')is distinct from (coverage->>'versionSha256'))then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('stale_coverage','Population is bound to an earlier corporate boundary.');end if;if population is not null and (population#>>'{dependencies,dependencySha256}')is distinct from (deps->>'dependencySha256')then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('stale_dependencies','Rebind the population to current source workpapers and reviews.');end if;if d is null or d='null'::jsonb then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('declaration_missing','Independent discovery statement is missing.');else
if (d->>'completeness')<>'declared_complete'or (d->'allControlledLocationsIncluded')<>'true'::jsonb or (d->'controlledFleetChecked')<>'true'::jsonb or jsonb_array_length(assets)=0 then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('discovery_incomplete','Discovery must explicitly cover the full controlled physical population and fleet.');end if;for x in select value from jsonb_array_elements((coverage#>'{snapshot,entities}'))loop if not (d->'coveredEntityIds')? ((x->>'id'))then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('entity_omitted','A corporate entity is absent from discovery.');end if;end loop;for x in select value from jsonb_array_elements((coverage#>'{snapshot,facilities}'))loop if not (d->'coveredFacilityIds')? ((x->>'id'))then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('facility_omitted','A corporate facility is absent from discovery.');end if;end loop;for x in select value from jsonb_array_elements((d->'coveredEntityIds'))loop if not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements((coverage#>'{snapshot,entities}'))e where (e->'id')=x)then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('unknown_entity','Discovery includes an unknown corporate entity.');end if;end loop;for x in select value from jsonb_array_elements((d->'coveredFacilityIds'))loop if not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements((coverage#>'{snapshot,facilities}'))f where (f->'id')=x)then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('unknown_facility','Discovery includes an unknown corporate facility.');end if;end loop;end if;
for a in select value from jsonb_array_elements(assets)loop
if(select count(*)from jsonb_array_elements(assets)x where (x->'assetId')=(a->'assetId'))>1 then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('duplicate_asset','Physical device identity is duplicated.',(a->>'assetId'),(a->>'sourceId'));end if;if not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements((coverage#>'{snapshot,entities}'))e where (e->'id')=(a->'entityId'))or((a->'facilityId')<>'null'::jsonb and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements((coverage#>'{snapshot,facilities}'))f where (f->'id')=(a->'facilityId')and (f->'entityId')=(a->'entityId')))then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('unknown_asset_location','Physical asset location is unresolved.',(a->>'assetId'),(a->>'sourceId'));end if;select x into s from jsonb_array_elements(sources)x where (x->'id')=(a->'sourceId');if s is null then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('unmatched_asset','Physical asset has no corporate fugitive source.',(a->>'assetId'),(a->>'sourceId'));elsif (s->'entityId')is distinct from (a->'entityId')or (s->'facilityId')is distinct from (a->'facilityId')then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('asset_source_mismatch','Physical and corporate source locations conflict.',(a->>'assetId'),(a->>'sourceId'));end if;if (a->'sourceId')<>'null'::jsonb and(select count(*)from jsonb_array_elements(assets)x where (x->'sourceId')=(a->'sourceId'))>1 then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('duplicate_source_mapping','Multiple devices share one corporate source.',(a->>'assetId'),(a->>'sourceId'));end if;
if (a->'gas')='null'::jsonb or (a->'capacityKg')='null'::jsonb or coalesce(((a->>'capacityKg'))::numeric,0)<=0 or (a->>'controlBasis')<>'owned_operational_control_full_year'or not(((a->>'gas')='R-410A'and (a->>'equipment')='fixed_hvac')or((a->>'gas')='HFC-134a'and (a->>'equipment')='fixed_refrigeration')or((a->>'gas')='HFC-227ea'and (a->>'equipment')in('fixed_fire_suppression','portable_fire_suppression')))then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('unsupported_asset','Gas, equipment, charge or operational control is unsupported.',(a->>'assetId'),(a->>'sourceId'));end if;
select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by n),'[]')into ws from jsonb_array_elements(workpapers)with ordinality q(x,n)where (x#>'{activity,assetId}')=(a->'assetId')and (x#>'{activity,binding,sourceId}')=(a->'sourceId');if jsonb_array_length(ws)<>1 then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('workpaper_missing_or_duplicate','Physical device requires exactly one effective workpaper.',(a->>'assetId'),(a->>'sourceId'));end if;for w in select value from jsonb_array_elements(ws)loop
if (w#>'{activity,binding,entityId}')is distinct from (a->'entityId')or (w#>'{activity,binding,facilityId}')is distinct from (a->'facilityId')or (w#>'{activity,gas}')is distinct from (a->'gas')or (w#>'{activity,equipment}')is distinct from (a->'equipment')or (w#>'{activity,capacityKg}')is distinct from (a->'capacityKg')then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('workpaper_asset_mismatch','Workpaper and physical device facts conflict.',(a->>'assetId'),(a->>'sourceId'));end if;if (w#>>'{activity,binding,coverageVersionId}')is distinct from (coverage->>'id')or (w#>>'{activity,binding,coverageVersionSha256}')is distinct from (coverage->>'versionSha256')then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('stale_workpaper','Source workpaper is bound to an earlier corporate boundary.',(a->>'assetId'),(a->>'sourceId'));end if;if (w->'calculation')='null'::jsonb or jsonb_array_length((w->'findings'))>0 then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('workpaper_blocked','Source method facts or evidence remain unresolved.',(a->>'assetId'),(a->>'sourceId'));end if;if (w#>>'{review,decision}')is distinct from 'accepted_bounded_internal'then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('source_review_required','Exact source workpaper requires separate internal review.',(a->>'assetId'),(a->>'sourceId'));end if;end loop;end loop;
for s in select value from jsonb_array_elements(sources)loop if not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(assets)a where (a->'sourceId')=(s->'id'))then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('orphan_source','Corporate fugitive source is absent from physical discovery.',null,(s->>'id'));end if;end loop;for w in select value from jsonb_array_elements(workpapers)loop if not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(assets)a where (a->'assetId')=(w#>'{activity,assetId}')and (a->'sourceId')=(w#>'{activity,binding,sourceId}'))then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('orphan_workpaper','Workpaper is absent from the physical/corporate source union.',(w#>>'{activity,assetId}'),(w#>>'{activity,binding,sourceId}'));end if;end loop;
if (review#>>'{decision}')is distinct from 'accepted_bounded_reconciliation'then findings:=findings||neuvetra.m77_f('population_review_required','Exact population reconciliation requires separate internal review.');end if;body:=jsonb_build_object('companyId',target_company,'dependencies',deps,'dependencySha256',(deps->'dependencySha256'),'populationVersionPin',case when population is null then 'null'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object('id',(population->'id'),'sha256',(population->'versionSha256'))end,'reviewPin',case when review is null then 'null'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object('id',(review->'id'),'sha256',(review->'decisionSha256'))end,'status',case when jsonb_array_length(findings)=0 then 'reconciled_bounded_synthetic'else 'blocked'end,'findings',findings,'assets',assets,'sourceIds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg((x->'id')order by n)from jsonb_array_elements(sources)with ordinality q(x,n)),'[]'),'worksheetIds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg((x->'streamId')order by (x->>'streamId')collate "C")from jsonb_array_elements(workpapers)x),'[]'),'emissionsTotals',null,'scope1Completeness','incomplete','corporateCompleteness','incomplete','releaseEligible',false,'assurance','none','limitations','["synthetic_only","declared_fugitive_reconciliation_only","scope1_incomplete","corporate_inventory_incomplete","factor_and_method_not_released","no_emissions_aggregation","requirements_not_determined","no_external_assurance"]'::jsonb);return body||jsonb_build_object('contentSha256',neuvetra.m67_hash(body));end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.m78_capacity(target_company uuid, extra integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare total bigint;begin select coalesce(sum(octet_length(export_text)+octet_length(neuvetra.m67_canonical(proof))),0)into total from neuvetra.scope1_versions where company_id=target_company;select total+coalesce(sum(octet_length(payload->>'html')+octet_length(payload->>'snapshotJson')),0)into total from neuvetra.scope1_reports where company_id=target_company;if total+extra>30000000 then raise exception 'retained history capacity exceeded'using errcode='54000';end if;end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.m78_corporate_findings(p jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
declare out jsonb:='[]';c jsonb:=p->'coverageVersion';s jsonb:=c->'snapshot';deps jsonb:=neuvetra.m78_dependencies(p,'inventory');f jsonb;row jsonb;domain text;source_id text;matched jsonb;candidate boolean;group_row boolean;discovery boolean;supported boolean;d jsonb;classification text;resolution jsonb;process_accepted boolean;begin
process_accepted:=p#>>'{process,review,decision}'='accepted_bounded_process_screen'and p#>'{process,version,activity,binding,coverageVersionId}'=c->'id'and p#>'{process,version,activity,binding,coverageVersionSha256}'=c->'versionSha256'and p#>'{process,version,dependencies}'=neuvetra.m78_dependencies(p,'process_screen')and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(neuvetra.m78_screen_findings(p#>'{process,version,activity}',p))x where x->>'classification'='functional_blocker');
for f in select value from jsonb_array_elements(c->'findings')loop row:=null;select x into row from jsonb_array_elements((s->'entities')||(s->'facilities')||(s->'relationships')||(s->'boundaryDecisions')||(s->'coverageItems')||(s->'requirements'))x where x->'id'=f->'recordId'limit 1;domain:=row->>'domain';classification:='functional_blocker';resolution:=null;
if f->>'code'in('unsupported_consolidation','unsupported_geography','unsupported_temporal_allocation','unsupported_boundary_relationship','control_evidence_missing','boundary_unreconciled','boundary_basis_missing','boundary_assertion_unverified')then classification:='functional_blocker';elsif f->>'code'in('synthetic_evidence_not_sufficient','methods_not_released')then classification:='release_blocker';elsif f->>'code'in('requirements_not_determined','requirement_unknown','requirement_conflicting')or domain is not null and domain not in('stationary_combustion','mobile_combustion','fugitive','process')then classification:='corporate_gap';elsif domain in('stationary_combustion','mobile_combustion','fugitive','process')then
source_id:=row->>'sourceId';select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x),'[]')into matched from jsonb_array_elements(p->'sourceVersions')x where x#>>'{version,activity,binding,sourceId}'=source_id;candidate:=jsonb_array_length(matched)=1 and matched#>>'{0,version,review,decision}'='accepted_bounded_internal'and matched#>'{0,version,calculation}'<>'null'::jsonb and matched#>'{0,version,activity,binding,coverageVersionId}'=c->'id'and matched#>'{0,version,activity,binding,coverageVersionSha256}'=c->'versionSha256';group_row:=row->'entityId'='null'::jsonb and row->'sourceId'='null'::jsonb;d:=p->case domain when 'mobile_combustion'then 'fleet'when 'stationary_combustion'then 'stationary'else 'fugitive'end;discovery:=group_row and domain<>'process'and d#>>'{reconciliation,status}'='reconciled_bounded_synthetic'and d#>>'{review,decision}'='accepted_bounded_reconciliation'and d->'version'<>'null'::jsonb and d#>'{version,activity,coverageVersionId}'=c->'id';supported:=case when domain='process'then group_row and process_accepted when source_id is not null then candidate else discovery end;
if supported and f->>'code'in('activity_unknown','evidence_incomplete','method_unsupported','screening_assertion_unverified')then classification:='resolved_bounded';resolution:=jsonb_build_object('ruleId',case when domain='process'then 'accepted_process_screen'when source_id is not null then 'current_reviewed_source'else 'current_reviewed_discovery'end,'pins',case when domain='process'then jsonb_build_array(deps->'processVersionPin',deps->'processReviewPin')when source_id is not null then jsonb_build_array(neuvetra.m78_pin(matched#>'{0,version}'),neuvetra.m78_pin(matched#>'{0,version,review}',true))else jsonb_build_array(neuvetra.m78_pin(d->'version'),neuvetra.m78_pin(d->'review',true))end);end if;end if;
out:=out||jsonb_build_array(neuvetra.m78_finding(f->>'code',f->>'message',f->>'recordId','corporate',classification,resolution));end loop;return out;end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.m78_dependencies(p jsonb, family text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$with body as(select jsonb_build_object('coveragePin',neuvetra.m78_pin(p->'coverageVersion'),'coverageReviewPin',neuvetra.m78_pin(p#>'{coverageVersion,review}',true),'processVersionPin',case when family='inventory'then neuvetra.m78_pin(p#>'{process,version}')else 'null'::jsonb end,'processReviewPin',case when family='inventory'then neuvetra.m78_pin(p#>'{process,review}',true)else 'null'::jsonb end,'sourcePins',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('family',x->'family','worksheetId',coalesce(x#>'{version,worksheetId}',x#>'{version,streamId}'),'sourceId',x#>'{version,activity,binding,sourceId}','physicalId',neuvetra.m78_physical(p,x->>'family',x->'version'),'version',neuvetra.m78_pin(x->'version'),'decision',neuvetra.m78_pin(x#>'{version,review}',true))order by coalesce(x#>>'{version,worksheetId}',x#>>'{version,streamId}')collate "C")from jsonb_array_elements(p->'sourceVersions')x),'[]'::jsonb),'discoveryPins',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('family',k,'version',neuvetra.m78_pin(p#>array[k,'version']),'decision',neuvetra.m78_pin(p#>array[k,'review'],true),'dependencySha256',p#>array[k,'reconciliation','dependencySha256'],'reconciliationSha256',p#>array[k,'reconciliation','contentSha256'])order by n)from unnest(array['fleet','stationary','fugitive'])with ordinality q(k,n)),'policySha256',case when family='inventory'then coalesce(p#>'{policy,policySha256}','null'::jsonb)else 'null'::jsonb end,'rulesVersion','m78-gross-scope1-v1')b)select b||jsonb_build_object('dependencySha256',neuvetra.m67_hash(b))from body$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.m78_report_detail_sections(s jsonb) RETURNS text LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ #variable_conflict use_column declare c jsonb:=s#>'{proof,coverageVersion,snapshot}';v jsonb; a jsonb;statements jsonb;discovery text;basis text;states jsonb:='{"unknown":"Unknown — unresolved","indicated":"Indicated source — unsupported","not_applicable_proposed":"Proposed not applicable — inspection and separate review required","covered_by_sources":"Covered by exact named physical sources"}';categories jsonb:='{"mineral_products":"Mineral products","chemical_production":"Chemical production","metal_production":"Metal production","oil_and_gas":"Oil and gas","waste_treatment":"Waste treatment","agricultural_biological":"Agricultural and biological activity","other_direct_process":"Other direct process emissions"}';begin v:=case when s->>'family'='process_screen'then s->'version'else s#>'{proof,process,version}'end;a:=case when v#>>'{activity,profile}'='synthetic-process-screen-v1'then v->'activity'else null end;statements:=coalesce(v->'statements','[]'::jsonb); if a is not null then discovery:='

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.m78_report_statements(s jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$

or review_payload->>'reviewedAt'!~'^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}[.][0-9]{3}Z$' or review_payload->>'decisionSha256'!~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$' or request->>'decision' is null or request->>'decision' not in('accepted_bounded_reconciliation','changes_requested') or neuvetra.m75_text_valid(request->'note',500) is not true or request->'acknowledgedLimitations' is distinct from '["synthetic_only","declared_roster_reconciliation_only","scope1_incomplete","corporate_inventory_incomplete","factor_and_method_not_released","no_emissions_aggregation","requirements_not_determined","no_external_assurance"]'::jsonb then raise exception 'invalid review request' using errcode='22023';end if;deps:=neuvetra.m75_current_dependencies(target_company);if request->>'expectedDependencySha256' is distinct from deps->>'dependencySha256' then raise exception 'review dependencies changed' using errcode='23505';end if;fingerprint:=neuvetra.m67_hash(jsonb_build_object('operation','review','actor',actor,'companyId',target_company,'rosterId',target_roster,'request',request-'idempotencyKey'));select * into old from neuvetra.controlled_fleet_requests where company_id=target_company and idempotency_key=(request->>'idempotencyKey')::uuid;if found then if old.fingerprint<>fingerprint or old.kind<>'review' or old.actor_id<>actor then raise exception 'idempotency conflict' using errcode='23505';end if;return old.record_id;end if;select vv.* into v from neuvetra.controlled_fleet_heads h join neuvetra.controlled_fleet_versions vv on vv.company_id=h.company_id and vv.id=h.version_id where h.company_id=target_company and h.id=target_roster and vv.id=(request->>'versionId')::uuid;if not found or v.version_sha256 is distinct from request->>'expectedVersionSha256' then raise exception 'review conflict' using errcode='23505';end if;if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements_text(v.payload->'contributorIds')x where x=actor::text) then raise exception 'contributors cannot review' using errcode='42501';end if;if request->>'decision'='accepted_bounded_reconciliation' and (neuvetra.m75_current_reconciliation(target_company,review_payload)#>>'{status}') is distinct from 'reconciled_bounded_synthetic' then raise exception 'blocked reconciliation cannot be accepted' using errcode='22023';end if;if review_payload->>'reviewerId' is distinct from actor::text or review_payload->>'versionId' is distinct from v.id::text or review_payload->>'versionSha256' is distinct from v.version_sha256 or review_payload->'dependencies' is distinct from deps or v.payload->'dependencies' is distinct from deps or review_payload->'decision' is distinct from request->'decision' or review_payload->'note' is distinct from request->'note' or review_payload->'acknowledgedLimitations' is distinct from request->'acknowledgedLimitations' or review_payload->>'decisionSha256' is distinct from neuvetra.m67_hash((review_payload-'decisionSha256')||jsonb_build_object('profile','synthetic-controlled-fleet-v1','companyId',target_company)) then raise exception 'invalid review' using errcode='22023';end if;insert into neuvetra.controlled_fleet_reviews values((review_payload->>'id')::uuid,target_company,v.id,review_payload,review_payload->>'decisionSha256',actor,(review_payload->>'reviewedAt')::timestamptz);insert into neuvetra.controlled_fleet_requests values(target_company,(request->>'idempotencyKey')::uuid,actor,'review',fingerprint,(review_payload->>'id')::uuid);insert into neuvetra.controlled_fleet_audit values(gen_random_uuid(),target_company,(review_payload->>'id')::uuid,'review',review_payload->>'decisionSha256',actor,(review_payload->>'reviewedAt')::timestamptz);return (review_payload->>'id')::uuid;end $function$

if (request->>'decision')='accepted_bounded_internal'and((v->'calculation')='null'::jsonb or jsonb_array_length((v->'findings'))>0)then raise exception 'blocked source'using errcode='22023';end if;if (request->>'decision')='accepted_bounded_reconciliation'and neuvetra.m77_reconciliation(target_company,neuvetra.m77_current_coverage(target_company),neuvetra.m77_current_workpapers(target_company),v,p)->>'status'<>'reconciled_bounded_synthetic'then raise exception 'blocked reconciliation'using errcode='22023';end if;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.can_manage_company(target_company_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from neuvetra.company_members m join neuvetra.staging_access a
 on a.user_id=m.user_id and a.company_id=m.company_id
 where m.company_id=target_company_id and m.user_id=auth.uid() and a.active and m.role in ('owner','admin'))

begin

    join neuvetra.inventory_review_decisions d on d.company_id=i.company_id and d.inventory_version_id=i.id
    join neuvetra.inventory_calculation_results c on c.company_id=i.company_id and c.id=i.calculation_id
    where i.company_id=target_company_id and i.id=prior_inventory_id and i.version=1 and d.outcome='approved_bounded_draft' for update of i;

    'version',1,'reportingYear',2023,'facilityId',predecessor.facility_id,'status','incomplete',
    'counts',jsonb_build_object('expected',12,'resolved',1,'reported',1,'estimated',0,'excluded',0,'missing',11,'calculationBearing',1),

      jsonb_build_object('month','2023-04','state','missing','version',1,'quantityMwh',null,'emissionsKgCo2e',null,'evidence',null,'reason','awaiting_source','method',null,'formula',null,'basisMonths',jsonb_build_array()),
      jsonb_build_object('month','2023-05','state','missing','version',1,'quantityMwh',null,'emissionsKgCo2e',null,'evidence',null,'reason','awaiting_source','method',null,'formula',null,'basisMonths',jsonb_build_array()),

    ),'totals',null,'fixtureSha256',null
  ) then raise exception 'register contract mismatch' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(payload) is distinct from 'object' or (select count(*) from jsonb_object_keys(payload)) is distinct from 13::bigint or payload->>'id' is distinct from register_id::text or payload->>'companyId' is distinct from target_company_id::text or payload->>'boundaryId' is distinct from predecessor.boundary_id::text or payload->>'previousInventoryVersionId' is distinct from prior_inventory_id::text
    or payload->>'version' is distinct from '1' or payload->>'reportingYear' is distinct from '2023' or payload->>'status' is distinct from 'incomplete' or payload->'totals' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb or payload->'fixtureSha256' is distinct from 'null'::jsonb
    or payload#>>'{counts,expected}' is distinct from '12' or payload#>>'{counts,resolved}' is distinct from '1' or payload#>>'{counts,reported}' is distinct from '1' or payload#>>'{counts,missing}' is distinct from '11' or payload#>>'{counts,calculationBearing}' is distinct from '1'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.create_synthetic_bill_calculation(target_company_id uuid, target_evidence_id uuid, target_activity_id uuid, calculation_id uuid, audit_id uuid, request_idempotency_key uuid, request_operation_fingerprint text, canonical_result_json text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  actor_id uuid := neuvetra.current_user_id();
  payload jsonb;
  stored_id uuid;
  linked record;
begin
  if actor_id is null then raise exception 'authentication required' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if not neuvetra.can_manage_company(target_company_id) then raise exception 'workspace not found' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if request_operation_fingerprint !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' then raise exception 'calculation contract mismatch' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
  begin payload := canonical_result_json::jsonb;
  exception when others then raise exception 'calculation contract mismatch' using errcode = '22023'; end;

  select a.bill_version_id, v.evidence_id, a.facility_id, a.boundary_id, j.id extraction_id, v.previous_version_id
    into linked
  from neuvetra.inventory_activity_versions a
  join neuvetra.bill_versions v on v.id = a.bill_version_id and v.company_id = a.company_id
  join neuvetra.bill_versions prior on prior.id = v.previous_version_id and prior.company_id = v.company_id
  join neuvetra.bill_evidence e on e.id = v.evidence_id and e.company_id = v.company_id
  join neuvetra.extraction_jobs j on j.evidence_id = e.id and j.company_id = e.company_id
  join neuvetra.facilities f on f.id = a.facility_id and f.company_id = a.company_id
  join neuvetra.reporting_boundaries b on b.id = a.boundary_id and b.company_id = a.company_id
  join neuvetra.boundary_facilities bf on bf.company_id = a.company_id and bf.boundary_id = a.boundary_id and bf.facility_id = a.facility_id
  where a.company_id = target_company_id and a.id = target_activity_id
    and v.evidence_id = target_evidence_id and v.version = 2 and prior.version = 1
    and v.electricity_kwh = 12346.000 and v.correction_reason = 'Synthetic review exercise'
    and a.bill_version_id = v.id and a.quantity_mwh = 12.346000 and a.unit = 'MWh' and a.status = 'draft'
    and a.facility_id = v.facility_id and f.name = 'Synthetic California office' and f.egrid_subregion = 'CAMX'
    and b.reporting_year = 2023 and b.approach = 'operational_control' and b.status = 'draft' and b.version = 1
    and e.sha256 = '0a97cd0976c03af0776214fc19bdc3d4f0c00e9c835f3e116574a6f375c8e135'
    and j.parser_version = 'm55-fixed-pdf-v1' and j.status = 'completed'
  for update of a, v, b;
  if linked.bill_version_id is null then raise exception 'calculation source not found' using errcode = '42501'; end if;

  if payload->>'contract_version' <> 'm56-linked-bill-calculation-result-v1'
    or payload->>'status' <> 'calculated'
    or payload#>>'{activity,quantity}' <> '12.346000'
    or payload#>>'{activity,unit}' <> 'MWh'
    or payload#>>'{activity,geography,egrid_subregion}' <> 'CAMX'
    or payload#>>'{activity,activity_period,start}' <> '2023-01-01'
    or payload#>>'{activity,activity_period,end}' <> '2023-01-31'
    or payload#>>'{conversion,id}' <> 'exact-kwh-to-mwh-v1'
    or payload#>>'{conversion,source}' <> '12346.000 kWh'
    or payload#>>'{conversion,result}' <> '12.346000 MWh'
    or payload#>>'{method,id}' <> 'scope2-location-based-egrid-subregion'
    or payload#>>'{method,version}' <> '2023-r2-camx-v1'
    or payload#>>'{factor,candidate_sha256}' <> '8770ae6238df8525e5250850fab248c934be33f459ed19cc1fa24bd0718cb356'
    or payload#>>'{factor,source,workbook_sha256}' <> '3dfbbcf2f949d58d5b2dbee3aab8150bd04a0c8ebb730ba1cd37a013bd4450ab'
    or payload#>>'{factor,total_output_co2e,value}' <> '195.0402888'
    or payload#>>'{factor,total_output_co2e,cell}' <> 'AI6'
    or payload#>>'{gwp_policy,policy_sha256}' <> 'fd9fd8973012da1a232dad7fc00db3013194751a92b34ab21dfd4f7b2c5148c5'
    or payload->>'input_snapshot_sha256' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    or payload#>>'{total,unrounded}' <> '2407.9674055248'
    or payload#>>'{total,display}' <> '2407.9674'
    or payload#>>'{reconciliation,component_sum}' <> '2407.8330020304'
    or payload#>>'{reconciliation,component_rounding_delta}' <> '0.1344034944'
    or payload#>>'{classification,factor}' <> 'development_candidate'
    or payload#>>'{classification,runtime}' <> 'not_released'
    or (payload#>>'{classification,release_eligible}')::boolean <> false
    or payload->>'result_payload_sha256' !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    or payload#>>'{method,adapter_implementation_sha256}' <> 'ae03b9146060187c63b6f3b8a253fbd61cd4f97a9aa97905481904eca45b061e'
    or payload#>>'{method,reviewed_engine_sha256}' <> '4ad28f3877d13f238bbbf7e8bfb1fc6241922b9def73712ec1b02fd80b51b82c'
    or payload#>>'{method,authority_record_sha256}' <> '9c63b2cb12fa2708f35d394e537ca5803e27f91c4647f33376abf75a6fb72b91'
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,company_id}' <> target_company_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,evidence_id}' <> target_evidence_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,activity_version_id}' <> target_activity_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,bill_version_id}' <> linked.bill_version_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,facility_id}' <> linked.facility_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,boundary_id}' <> linked.boundary_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,extraction_id}' <> linked.extraction_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,previous_bill_version_id}' <> linked.previous_version_id::text
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,parser_version}' <> 'm55-fixed-pdf-v1'
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,activity_version}' <> '1'
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,correction_reason}' <> 'Synthetic review exercise'
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,service_period,start}' <> '2023-01-01'
    or payload#>>'{input_snapshot,service_period,end}' <> '2023-01-31'
    or payload#>>'{gas_results,co2,mass}' <> '2399.4607843584'
    or payload#>>'{gas_results,ch4,mass}' <> '0.14000364'
    or payload#>>'{gas_results,ch4,co2e}' <> '3.92010192'
    or payload#>>'{gas_results,n2o,mass}' <> '0.0168004368'
    or payload#>>'{gas_results,n2o,co2e}' <> '4.452115752'
    or payload#>>'{trace,0,step}' <> 'reviewed_bill_conversion'
    or payload#>>'{trace,1,result}' <> '2407.9674055248'
    or payload#>>'{trace,2,result}' <> '2407.8330020304'
    or payload#>>'{trace,3,result}' <> '0.1344034944'
  then raise exception 'calculation contract mismatch' using errcode = '22023'; end if;

  insert into neuvetra.inventory_calculation_results (
    id, company_id, activity_version_id, bill_version_id, evidence_id, facility_id, boundary_id,
    method_id, method_version, adapter_implementation_sha256, reviewed_engine_sha256, authority_record_sha256, factor_id, factor_version,
    factor_candidate_sha256, source_sha256, gwp_policy_id, gwp_policy_version, gwp_policy_sha256,
    input_snapshot_sha256, result_payload_sha256, source_quantity_kwh, normalized_quantity_mwh,
    unrounded_kg_co2e, display_kg_co2e, status, classification, release_eligible,
    result_payload_json, result_payload, idempotency_key, operation_fingerprint, created_by
  ) values (
    calculation_id, target_company_id, target_activity_id, linked.bill_version_id, linked.evidence_id,
    linked.facility_id, linked.boundary_id, payload#>>'{method,id}', payload#>>'{method,version}',
    payload#>>'{method,adapter_implementation_sha256}', payload#>>'{method,reviewed_engine_sha256}', payload#>>'{method,authority_record_sha256}', payload#>>'{factor,id}', payload#>>'{factor,version}',
    payload#>>'{factor,candidate_sha256}', payload#>>'{factor,source,workbook_sha256}',
    payload#>>'{gwp_policy,id}', payload#>>'{gwp_policy,version}', payload#>>'{gwp_policy,policy_sha256}',
    payload->>'input_snapshot_sha256', payload->>'result_payload_sha256', 12346.000, 12.346000,
    2407.9674055248, 2407.9674, 'draft', 'development_candidate', false,
    canonical_result_json, payload, request_idempotency_key, request_operation_fingerprint, actor_id
  ) on conflict (company_id, activity_version_id, method_version) do nothing returning id into stored_id;

  if stored_id is null then
    select id into stored_id from neuvetra.inventory_calculation_results
      where company_id = target_company_id and activity_version_id = target_activity_id and method_version = '2023-r2-camx-v1'
        and result_payload = payload and result_payload_json = canonical_result_json
        and operation_fingerprint = request_operation_fingerprint;
    if stored_id is null then raise exception 'calculation conflict' using errcode = '23505'; end if;
    return stored_id;
  end if;

  insert into neuvetra.calculation_audit_log values (
    audit_id, target_company_id, actor_id, stored_id, 'calculation.created',
    jsonb_build_object('activity_version_id', target_activity_id, 'method_version', '2023-r2-camx-v1', 'result_payload_sha256', payload->>'result_payload_sha256'), now()
  );
  return stored_id;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.m74_statement(a jsonb, coverage jsonb, kind text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$declare s jsonb:=coverage->'snapshot';e jsonb;f jsonb;src jsonb;body jsonb;begin select x into e from jsonb_array_elements(s->'entities')x where x->>'id'=a#>>'{binding,entityId}';select x into f from jsonb_array_elements(s->'facilities')x where x->>'id'=a#>>'{binding,facilityId}';select x into src from jsonb_array_elements(s->'sources')x where x->>'id'=a#>>'{binding,sourceId}';if kind='fuel' then body:=jsonb_build_object('profile','m74-synthetic-fuel-statement-v1','companyLabel',s->'companyLabel','entityLabel',e->'legalName','facilityLabel',f->'name','sourceLabel',src->'name','binding',a->'binding','period',a->'period','vehicle',a->'vehicle','quantityUnit','US_gallon','fuelComposition','fossil_diesel_only','statement',a->'fuelStatement');return 'SYNTHETIC — NOT A FUEL RECEIPT OR INDEPENDENT MEASUREMENT'||chr(10)||neuvetra.m67_canonical(body)||chr(10);elsif kind='mileage' then body:=jsonb_build_object('profile','m74-synthetic-mileage-statement-v1','companyLabel',s->'companyLabel','entityLabel',e->'legalName','facilityLabel',f->'name','sourceLabel',src->'name','binding',a->'binding','period',a->'period','vehicle',a->'vehicle','distanceUnit','vehicle_mile','tripCoverage','all_trip_locations_including_interstate','statement',a->'mileageStatement');return 'SYNTHETIC — NOT AN ODOMETER RECORD OR INDEPENDENT MEASUREMENT'||chr(10)||neuvetra.m67_canonical(body)||chr(10);else raise exception 'invalid statement kind' using errcode='22023';end if;end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION neuvetra.m74_text(v jsonb, maximum integer)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'neuvetra', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$declare s text:=v#>>'{}';begin if jsonb_typeof(v) is distinct from 'string' or length(s) not between 1 and maximum or s<>btrim(s) or s~U&'^[\00A0\1680\2000-\200A\2028\2029\202F\205F\3000\FEFF]|[\00A0\1680\2000-\200A\2028\2029\202F\205F\3000\FEFF]$' or s<>normalize(s,NFC) or s~'[[:cntrl:]]' then raise exception 'invalid text' using errcode='22023';end if;return s;end $function$
